prompt: An operator runs the build command with `--target process`. Is that accepted, and if not, what does the command do instead?
check: Deterministic, no model call: PASS when the answer says the option value is rejected and identifies it as a usage error over the two accepted targets. A process is generated and scored on every agent-spec build and published only when recommended, but it is not a target value, so an answer that says the flag builds the multi-agent process fails.
